title: Stop Paying by the Letter: Accelerating Full-Chip RTL Simulation with Host-Side Tokenized Logging
abstract: arXiv:2610.27356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Firmware diagnostic logging (printf) is an essential debug instrument in full-chip SoC design verification, yet it imposes a heavy tax on cycle-accurate RTL simulation: formatting a 30-character, 1-argument message on a simulated CPU and serializing it through an MMIO aperture costs 3.04 to 15.23 $\mu$s per call (15.27 $\mu$s unweighted / 15.08 $\mu$s print-weighted critical-path mean on Suite A). Unlike embedded tokenizers that target flash footprint and wire bytes with offline decoding, RTL simulation is governed by a two-regime cost function---cross-fabric SoC paths are dominated by MMIO bus stalls (84.7% of call latency) whereas local subsystem paths are dominated by on-core vsprintf formatting (61.7%)---and requires live, zero-simulation-time string reconstruction to drive UVM scoreboards.   We present a host-side in-simulation tokenized logging architecture for heterogeneous multi-core SoCs that eliminates both bottlenecks with z

translated_title: 告别按字母付费：利用主机侧令牌化日志加速全芯片RTL仿真
translated_abstract: 固件诊断日志（printf）是全芯片SoC设计验证中必不可少的调试手段，但它给周期精确的RTL仿真带来了沉重的开销：在仿真CPU上格式化一条30字符、单参数的消息并通过MMIO接口序列化传输，每次调用需耗时3.04至15.23微秒（在Suite A测试集上，未加权关键路径均值为15.27微秒，按打印加权的均值为15.08微秒）。与那些面向闪存占用和线缆字节数、采用离线解码的嵌入式分词器不同，RTL仿真受一种双区域成本函数支配——跨fabric的SoC路径主要受MMIO总线停顿影响（占调用延迟的84.7%），而本地子系统路径则主要受片上vsprintf格式化影响（占61.7%）——并且需要实时的、零仿真时间的字符串重建来驱动UVM记分板。我们提出了一种面向异构多核SoC的主机侧仿真内令牌化日志架构，通过……消除了这两个瓶颈。
tldr: 提出一种面向异构多核SoC的主机侧仿真内令牌化日志架构，将printf的格式化与MMIO串行化开销转移至主机端并以零仿真时间重建字符串，从而同时消除MMIO总线停顿与片上vsprintf格式化两大瓶颈，大幅加速全芯片RTL仿真。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a host-side in-simulation tokenized logging architecture for heterogeneous multi-core SoCs that eliminates both MMIO bus stalls and on-core vsprintf formatting bottlenecks, accelerating full-chip RTL simulation via zero-simulation-time string reconstruction.
